recommendations: Add a mutant that specifically flips only the hidden-state name/encoding reference (e.g., an otherwise-correct report but naming a legitimate GRANT state as the sink) to directly exercise SR1 in isolation from SR2/SR3.
Add mutants targeting FR3 (e.g., ambiguous/hedged overall_assessment) and FR4 (e.g., candidate referencing a state name but no signal/bit-pattern) to raise mutation score.
Consider making the SR1 detection strategy less dependent on the same textual cues used for SR2 to ensure independent test signal.
